title: 格温·蓝线高窗
description: 蓝色双卷发格温穿完整端庄裙装立于高窗前，巨大剪刀安全收合垂持，蓝白褶面与强侧光构成利落剪影。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Gwen is an adult doll-inspired woman with bright blue curled twin ponytails, a decorative button-like eye detail, and a blue-black frilled dress silhouette. Preserve her refined face and natural adult comic proportions, with a modest opaque bodice, long-sleeved blouse, opaque stockings, gloves, and shoes. Her enormous ornate scissors remain fully closed and held low beside her body, never cutting or raised.
art_direction.scene: Show her standing at a slight three-quarter angle in a broad windowed stone hall, free hand resting near her waist and the closed scissors clearly separate at her side. Strong cold light catches blue hair and fabric edges, while angular wax-crayon shadow blocks replace frilly softness. One distant arch and a quiet sky provide a spacious dignified background.
art_direction.palette: cobalt blue, ivory, deep teal, silver edge light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
